crpc_pt01_ar_amp_t878a_abiraterone_resis.title: Patient CRPC-01: Metastatic CRPC with AR Amplification and Acquired T878A LBD Mutation
crpc_pt01_ar_amp_t878a_abiraterone_resis.citation: COU-AA-302 Trial; Ryan et al. (2013) NEJM; Romanel et al. (2015) Sci Transl Med

clinical_history.primary_driver: High-level AR copy number amplification + secondary AR T878A ligand-binding mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Transient PSA response for 4.2 months, explosive osteoblastic bone metastases, death at 11.4 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: AR-T878A mutation expands ligand promiscuity, enabling activation by exogenous progesterone and glucocorticoids despite CYP17A1 inhibition

crpc_pt02_ar_v7_splice_variant_enzalutam.title: Patient CRPC-02: Metastatic CRPC with Constitutive AR-V7 Splice Variant Refractory to Enzalutamide
crpc_pt02_ar_v7_splice_variant_enzalutam.citation: AFFIRM Trial; Scher et al. (2012) NEJM; Antonarakis et al. (2014) NEJM

clinical_history.primary_driver: Expression of truncated AR-V7 lacking C-terminal ligand-binding domain (LBD)
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary refractory, rapid PSA progression at 1.8 months, visceral hepatic metastases, death at 5.5 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Truncated AR-V7 lacks the drug-binding pocket entirely, remaining constitutively localized to the nucleus and driving transcription

crpc_pt03_brca2_germline_loss_olaparib_r.title: Patient CRPC-03: HRD-Positive CRPC with Biallelic BRCA2 Inactivation and PARP Sensitivity
crpc_pt03_brca2_germline_loss_olaparib_r.citation: PROfound Trial; de Bono et al. (2020) NEJM; Mateo et al. (2015) NEJM

clinical_history.primary_driver: Deleterious BRCA2 truncating mutation, homologous recombination deficiency
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Exceptional deep response, >90% PSA decline, radiographic PFS 19.1 months (Long-Term Survivor)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: None initially; synthetic lethality between trapped PARP1 complexes and unrepaired double-strand DNA breaks causes catastrophic genomic collapse

crpc_pt04_pten_null_akt_hyperactivated_r.title: Patient CRPC-04: Reciprocal AR-AKT Driven CRPC with Biallelic PTEN Genomic Deletion
crpc_pt04_pten_null_akt_hyperactivated_r.citation: IPATential150 Trial; Sweeney et al. (2021) Lancet; Carver et al. (2011) Cancer Cell

clinical_history.primary_driver: Homozygous PTEN deletion, loss of PIP3 dephosphorylation, hyperactive Akt/mTOR
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary resistance, progressive pelvic lymphadenopathy at 3.1 months, death at 8.0 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: AR inhibition relieves feedback inhibition on HER3/Akt, while PTEN loss sustains constitutive Mcl-1/Bcl-2 survival and Cyclin D1 translation

crpc_pt05_neuroendocrine_transformation_.title: Patient CRPC-05: Treatment-Emergent Neuroendocrine Prostate Cancer (t-NEPC) with Double TP53/RB1 Loss
crpc_pt05_neuroendocrine_transformation_.citation: Beltran et al. (2016) Nat Med; Ku et al. (2017) Science; Mu et al. (2017) Science

clinical_history.primary_driver: Concurrent biallelic loss of TP53 and RB1, lineage plasticity, AR-indifference
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Brief partial response for 3.5 months, fulminant visceral and CNS metastases, death at 7.2 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Double loss of RB1 and TP53 abolishes cell cycle restraint, drives SOX2/E2F1 expression, and disables DNA-damage checkpoints

crpc_pt06_smpc_msi_high_pembrolizumab_re.title: Patient CRPC-06: Mismatch Repair Deficient (MSI-High) CRPC with Curative Immunotherapy Response
crpc_pt06_smpc_msi_high_pembrolizumab_re.citation: KEYNOTE-199; Antonarakis et al. (2020) JCO; Nava Rodrigues et al. (2018) CCR

clinical_history.subtype: Mismatch Repair Deficient (dMMR / MSI-High) Metastatic CRPC
clinical_history.primary_driver: MSH2/MSH6 loss, hypermutated genome, high tumor mutational burden (>25 mut/Mb)
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Durable Complete Remission (CR), undetectable PSA >38 months (Cured / Exceptional Responder)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Absence of oncogenic anti-apoptotic traps allows cytotoxic T-cell perforin/granzyme B to easily collapse cancer attractors

crpc_pt07_tmprss2_erg_wnt_driven.title: Patient CRPC-07: TMPRSS2-ERG Fusion CRPC with Active Wnt/Beta-Catenin Taxane Resistance
crpc_pt07_tmprss2_erg_wnt_driven.citation: TAX 327 Trial; Tannock et al. (2004) NEJM; Robinson et al. (2015) Cell; TCGA-PRAD

clinical_history.primary_driver: TMPRSS2-ERG gene rearrangement, activating CTNNB1 mutation, MYC overexpression
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary chemo-resistance, progression at 4.6 months, bulky retroperitoneal adenopathy, death at 10.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: ERG cooperates with beta-catenin to upregulate ABCB1/MDR1 efflux pumps and repress pro-apoptotic BAX

crpc_pt08_pan_refractory_arv7_pten_p53_t.title: Patient CRPC-08: Pan-Refractory AR-V7 / PTEN-Loss / TP53-Mutant Triplet Metastatic CRPC
crpc_pt08_pan_refractory_arv7_pten_p53_t.citation: CARD Trial; de Wit et al. (2019) NEJM; Mateo et al. (2020) NEJM; Robinson et al. (2015) Cell

clinical_history.primary_driver: Concurrent AR-V7 splice, homozygous PTEN deletion, and TP53 hotspot mutation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary failure, rapid visceral progression at 2.1 months, liver failure, death at 4.3 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Simultaneous disruption of AR, PTEN/PI3K, and p53 axes locks the cell in high MCL-1/BCL-xL/XIAP survival state impervious to tubulin or DNA agents
